title: 42 U.S.C. §§ 12131–12132 — ADA Title II: Public Services
enacting_law: Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, Pub. L. 101-336, Title II, §§ 201–202, 104 Stat. 337
major_amendment: ADA Amendments Act of 2008, Pub. L. 110-325 — disability definition amendments apply to Title II
implementing_regulation: 28 CFR Part 35 (DOJ Title II implementing regulations)
verified_note: USC tool returned 'not found' for Title 42 §§ 12131–12132. Text from training knowledge. STEWARD MUST VERIFY full text at uscode.house.gov → Title 42 → Chapter 126 → §§ 12131–12132 before citing in federal court filings.
case_application: All court proceedings (PC §1368 competency; probate conservatorship; criminal case 04-23-01959); CalVCB administrative proceedings; Antioch PD police interactions; DDS administrative determinations. All are public entities — no threshold, no exemption.
key_cases: Tennessee v. Lane, 541 U.S. 509 (2004) — Congress validly abrogated state sovereign immunity for Title II court access claims; George Lane paraplegic courthouse stairs; fundamental right of access to courts
Olmstead v. L.C., 527 U.S. 581 (1999) — unnecessary institutionalization = Title II discrimination; integration mandate; states must have plans for community-based placement
sovereign_immunity_note: Tennessee v. Lane (2004): state sovereign immunity ABROGATED for Title II claims involving fundamental rights, including access to courts. States cannot claim 11th Amendment immunity from Title II court access suits.
unruh_per_se: CIV § 51(f) — ADA Title II violation is per se Unruh Civil Rights Act violation; $4,000 minimum statutory damages per offense in California court
